adapter.goal: Map Material 3 Tabs, NavigationBar, and NavigationRail active-indicator geometry, selectors, and motion into one packet so shared foundation work is evidence-backed.
source_precedence: Compose Material3 for toolkit indicator measurement, placement, and motion scheme vocabulary
Material Web for Material token names and active indicator DOM/CSS outcomes
Material UI for web-facing Tabs indicator measurement and slot boundaries
Base UI for headless active tab geometry exposure and hidden-until-measured behavior

limitations: This packet classifies the boundary between recipe-owned target geometry and shared Material active-indicator paint/motion; it is not a full screenshot parity claim.
Tabs, NavigationBar, and NavigationRail use different upstream geometry models, so only the paint/motion canvas layer is shared.
Fixed-timestep diagnostics prove Fret-side indicator motion is script-addressable; upstream pixel matching remains a later hardening step.

parts.label: Material 3 Tabs active indicator geometry and motion

facts: Compose Material3 TabRow computes selected tab positions and gives indicators a tabIndicatorOffset API that animates offset and width with the Material motion scheme.
Material Web tabs render an indicator element inside each tab and animate from the previous indicator rect to the new rect.
Material UI Tabs measures the selected tab relative to the tabs container and updates indicator start and size only when the measured delta changes.
Tabs records recipe-owned tab bounds in LayoutProbeList and falls back to evenly divided chrome width before bounds are available.
Tabs passes the target rect, color, shape, and Material FastSpatial spring to the shared active-indicator layer.
Tabs exposes a stable dotted active-indicator test id for diagnostics and automation.

checks.expected: Tabs exposes root/chrome/active-indicator/item selectors and renders the active-indicator layer from recipe-owned tab geometry.

promotion.reason: Tabs indicator movement is motion-sensitive and should stay covered by fixed-timestep diagnostics.

parts.label: Material 3 NavigationBar active indicator geometry and motion

facts: Compose Material3 NavigationBarItem measures the icon slot, derives active indicator width and height from icon size plus token padding, and keeps ripple and indicator as separate layout ids.
Compose animates selected indicator alpha with DefaultEffects and indicator size with FastSpatial.
Material Web navigation tabs render an active-indicator element whose opacity, width, height, color, and shape are token-driven.
NavigationBar records selected icon-slot bounds in LayoutProbeList and uses token fallback geometry when the slot has not been measured.
NavigationBar keeps item semantics, ripple, icon, label, and badge recipe-local while delegating active-indicator paint/motion to the shared foundation helper.
NavigationBar exposes stable dotted part ids for root chrome, active indicator, item chrome, icon, label, and badge.

checks.expected: NavigationBar active indicator is addressable, driven by selected icon-slot geometry, and painted through the shared Material active-indicator layer.

promotion.reason: NavigationBar indicator movement should be covered with fixed-timestep pixel-change evidence.

parts.label: Material 3 NavigationRail active indicator geometry and motion

facts: Compose Material3 NavigationRailItem measures icon, optional label, indicator ripple, and active indicator within the item layout.
Compose NavigationRail keeps active indicator placement tied to the selected icon slot and label visibility mode.
Material Web navigation tabs use token-driven active-indicator width, height, color, shape, and selected-state opacity.
NavigationRail records selected icon-slot bounds in LayoutProbeList and intentionally keeps rail-specific item height, label mode, and badge placement in the recipe.
NavigationRail delegates shared canvas paint, target clamping, and Material FastSpatial spring motion to the active-indicator foundation helper.
NavigationRail exposes stable dotted part ids for root chrome, active indicator, item chrome, icon, label, and badge.

checks.expected: NavigationRail active indicator is addressable, driven by selected icon-slot geometry, and painted through the shared Material active-indicator layer.

promotion.reason: NavigationRail indicator movement should be covered with fixed-timestep pixel-change evidence.

parts.label: Material active indicator shared foundation boundary

facts: Upstream implementations keep target measurement component-specific because each surface has different placement constraints.
The reusable part across surfaces is the visual indicator layer behavior: it is hidden or empty when there is no selected/measured target and otherwise tracks a target rect.
Headless tabs expose active tab position and size separately from styling, which matches a split between recipe geometry and foundation paint/motion.
Fret keeps tab width, nav icon-slot bounds, and rail label-mode geometry in each recipe.
Fret shares only ActiveIndicatorRect, Material spring conversion, clamped absolute canvas paint, and optional semantics decoration.
No mechanism-layer or fret-ui-kit policy gap is proven by this packet.

checks.expected: The shared foundation helper has Tabs, NavigationBar, and NavigationRail consumers and targeted unit tests for empty/clamped targets.

promotion.reason: This is a Material crate foundation split with three recipe consumers; no lower-layer promotion is needed.
